title: Console Suggestions: improve error states for missing/insufficient telemetry + add logging
author: Nora Ahmed
description:
Problem: In the Suggestions beta we currently collapse a bunch of “no data” cases into a generic empty state (“Insufficient telemetry”). This is confusing for customers and Support (SUP-19361 theme) and makes it hard to distinguish true lack of traffic vs telemetry freshness vs baseline computation gaps.

This PR: (1) adds standardized “data availability” reasons in the BFF-to-UI boundary and uses them to render more specific empty/error states in the Suggestions list + detail drawer, (2) updates user-facing copy to be explicit about what’s missing and what to do next (without overpromising), and (3) adds structured logging + lightweight metrics so we can track how often customers hit these states and debug faster.

Scope:
- Console UI: new EmptyState variants + callouts in detail drawer when savings/risk are unavailable due to telemetry.
- Console BFF: maps suggestions-service / telemetry errors into a stable reason enum for UI rendering.
- Observability: add structured logs with reason + suggestion_id (when present) and a counter per reason.

Notes:
- This does NOT change suggestions generation logic; it only improves presentation and logging.
- Copy reviewed with Design; intentionally avoids “guaranteed savings” language.

Manual test plan:
- Staging tenant with no traffic -> see “No recent traffic” state.
- Staging tenant with traffic but baseline older than threshold -> see “Telemetry delayed” state.
- Force 503 from suggestions-service -> see “Suggestions temporarily unavailable” error state and retry.
- Open a suggestion with missing basis fields -> see inline “Savings estimate unavailable” callout + link to docs.

Rollout:
- Behind existing suggestions_beta feature flag. No schema breaking changes (UI handles unknown reasons as generic fallback).

ux_copy_notes: NO_RECENT_TRAFFIC: “No recent traffic for this route. Suggestions require recent requests to estimate savings.”
INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE: “Not enough data yet. We need more requests to confidently estimate savings.”
STALE_BASELINE / METERING_DELAY: “Telemetry is delayed. Estimates will appear once usage data is up to date.”
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: “Suggestions are temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.”
All states include: “Learn more” link to docs section “Why am I not seeing suggestions?”
logging_and_metrics: Structured log (console-bff): suggestions_data_unavailable { tenant_id_hash, workspace_id, route_id?, suggestion_id?, reason, upstream_status?, request_id }
No raw token counts or cost values are logged
review_conversation: Chloe Martin: Can we confirm this doesn’t require a suggestions-service deploy? I’m wary of any contract changes during beta.

Nora Ahmed (author): No service changes required. UI reads data_availability_reason from BFF only; BFF derives it from existing upstream fields (telemetry freshness + HTTP errors). Unknowns fall back to generic state.
Logan Wright: For STALE_BASELINE vs METERING_DELAY — what’s the distinction? Are we exposing internal pipeline details?

Nora Ahmed (author): Distinction is only used for debugging + copy nuance; both present as “Telemetry is delayed” to users. We keep the enum separate so we can see which failure mode dominates without leaking internals in UI.
Tessa Morgan: Copy nit: replace “require” with “use” and avoid implying the customer did something wrong. Also ensure the CTA doesn’t say “Fix telemetry” (sounds like config work).
Nora Ahmed (author): Updated copy per DES-188 guidance: “Suggestions use recent requests…” and CTA now “Learn more” + “Try again”.
Dev Patel: Support asks for a clear line: if the customer has traffic but still sees this, what do we tell them? Can we surface “Last updated” timestamp anywhere?

Nora Ahmed (author): Added optional “Telemetry last updated” line when we have a baseline timestamp (detail drawer only). For list page we keep it minimal to avoid noise. Support can reference the timestamp in screenshots.
Chloe Martin: Please add a unit test for the fallback behavior when upstream adds a new reason we don’t know.
Nora Ahmed (author): Added test: unknown reason -> UNKNOWN -> generic empty state; no throw.
release_notes: Console Suggestions beta: clearer empty/error states when telemetry is missing or delayed; improved user copy and added logging/metrics for faster Support triage.
